description_en: Disassociate host accounts from a shared key
description_zh: 移除主机账号和主机共享密钥的关联
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost detach-host-accounts-from-host-share-key --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-share-key-id 11 --host-account-ids 1_,_2_,_3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachHostAccountsFromHostShareKey

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The shared key ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html operation to query the shared key ID
parameters.help_zh:
主机共享密钥的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_share_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The host account IDs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462975.html operation to query the host account IDs
parameters.help_zh:
主机账号ID列表。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462975.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_account_ids

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Code.description_en: The error code returned. If OK is returned, the disassociation was successful. If a different error code is returned, the disassociation failed
Code.description_zh: 错误码。错误码为OK时，表示移除成功；其他错误码表示移除失败

HostAccountId.description_en: The ID of the host account

HostShareKeyId.description_en: The ID of the shared key

Message.example: The host account does not exist
